header.headline: Security & responsible use
header.subhead: How we secure this site, how to report a vulnerability, and the responsible-use boundary for anything we publish.

sections.title: Securing this site
bullets: HTTPS enforced across all pages; modern TLS configuration.
Minimal data collection — the contact form collects only what routing requires.
Access to content and infrastructure is limited to maintainers with individual accounts and multi-factor authentication.
Dependency and content review on every pull request; releases are tagged and auditable.

sections.title: Vulnerability disclosure
sections.body: Report vulnerabilities in the landing repository or site through the GitHub Security Advisory channel (private reporting) or the security tab of the repository. Do not open a public issue for exploitable findings.
steps: Describe the issue, affected path, and reproduction steps.
Allow reasonable time for a fix before public discussion.
We acknowledge reports promptly and keep the reporter informed.
Credit is offered unless you prefer to remain anonymous.

sections.title: Responsible use
sections.body: Content here describes a defensive security product. Published material is intended for defenders evaluating or operating the platform in environments they are authorised to assess.
bullets: Do not use our content to target systems you are not authorised to test.
Do not reproduce site material to create unverified claims about capabilities.
Lab-validated figures describe lab conditions; do not present them as production guarantees.
Requests that ask us to support unauthorised access, disruption, or evasion are declined.

sections.title: Product security (under agreement)
sections.body: Security architecture, deployment hardening, and support channels for the Sibernetick product are covered in the commercial agreement and its documentation — not on this public site.

sections.title: Note
sections.body: This page describes the landing site's controls. Certifications and audit reports for the product, when they exist, will be shared under NDA through the contact channel.
